C9000320.statement: Campaign verification frontier. The dependencies below describe the manuscript-verification alternative, not a proof of either main theorem or exclusion of a future substantive refutation.

C320_PAIR.statement: introduction.tex, thm:pair; normalizer.tex:437-466: homotopy-equivalent, nonhomeomorphic closed aspherical four-manifolds with common word-hyperbolic fundamental group.

C320_SELF.statement: introduction.tex, thm:self-map; extension.tex:341-367: delta on the chosen model M is a self-homotopy equivalence not realized by a homeomorphism.

C320_MODELS.statement: models.tex, mod:models and mod:actions; extension.tex, ext:development: the two doubled-chamber models are closed manifolds marked by the same aspherical Q_2.

C320_BASE_CHAMBER.statement: chambers.tex, ch:homotopy-type, ch:poincare-chamber and ch:cover-data; reflection.tex, refl:input: the constructed lifted chambers have the specified Poincare data and aspherical reflection developments.

C320_EVEN.statement: chambers.tex, ch:even-filling: S_2 has the relative marked filling needed to construct the two manifold models.

C320_REFLECTED_ODD.statement: reflection.tex, refl:odd-models; models.tex, mod:odd-models: an odd reflected/label-quotient manifold model would yield a forbidden marked filling.

C320_HYPERBOLIC.statement: hyperbolicity.tex, hyp:cubical-model, hyp:bounded-grids, hyp:grids-to-triangles and hyp:word-hyperbolic: the support cubulation gives word-hyperbolicity of Pi.

C320_FINITE_OUT.statement: hyperbolicity.tex, hyp:no-vc-splitting and hyp:finite-out: duality excludes virtually cyclic splittings and yields finite Out(Pi).

C320_NORMALIZER.statement: normalizer.tex, nor:rigidity and nor:normalizer: N_Out(Pi)(A) = A times <delta>.

C320_ACTIONS.statement: extension.tex, ext:embedding and ext:outer-actions: A and B_ell embed as the prescribed homeomorphism-realized outer subgroups of M and N.

C320_NONCONJ.statement: extension.tex, ext:nonconjugate: A and B_ell are nonconjugate, as detected by counts of elements with finite-order lifts.

C320_CYCLIC.statement: cyclic.tex, cyc:criterion: the even-model and eventual odd-nonmodel hypotheses obstruct the cyclic involution on a manifold model.

C320_SYLOW.statement: cyclic.tex, sym:criterion: the stated finite-outer-group, normalizer, realized subgroup and nonconjugacy hypotheses exclude homeomorphisms.

C320_ODD.statement: formal.tex, for:odd-nonfilling: for every odd d >= 3, S_d has no marked filling.

C320_TENSOR.statement: tensors.tex, ten:assignment and ten:odd-cycle: the stated algebraic formal data force an endpoint assignment, impossible on the five-red/five-blue odd cycle.

C320_CUTS.statement: formal.tex, for:cuts: a marked filling gives connected punctured-smooth vertex pieces, smooth torus-boundary cuts, retained markings and disk-bounding laws.

C320_LINEAR.statement: formal.tex, for:linear and for:tangent-isomorphism: the degree-two isomorphism, fixed-extra degree-one map and coordinate-line peripheral directions give the required tangent difference isomorphism.

C320_EDGE.statement: formal.tex, for:edge-input; imported MT 4.4 and 4.5: based single-cut slices represent full nonreduced flatness quotients and identify actual curvature and gradient ideals.

C320_ALGEBRAIC.statement: formal.tex:600-608; imported MT 5.1: central edge potentials are formally right equivalent to algebraic germs with algebraic marked holonomy-entry lifts on the entire critical scheme.

C320_VERTEX.statement: formal.tex, for:vertex-identities: the mixed-sign vertex section has S(M) in I^2 and restricted gradient Lr with a unit full-column minor, retaining the actual fixed residual list.

C320_CORRECT.statement: formal.tex, for:exact-before-algebraic: maximal-ideal-adic correction gives exact action zero, the same actual residual/gradient ideal, and unchanged central tangents.

C320_LAWS.statement: formal.tex, for:four-product-ideal and for:mixed-holonomy: the four-slot Brunnian laws and independent adjoint tests give all mixed source/holonomy-entry products in the actual residual ideal.

C320_REPLACE.statement: formal.tex, for:replacement-estimates and for:polynomial-weight: logarithmic replacement and full-parameter nilpotent correction preserve all mixed memberships and the same gradient ideal.

C320_FORMAL.statement: formal.tex, for:formal-data: all three endpoint-assignment hypotheses hold over C((sigma)), with algebraic edge functions and the full individual-square parameter rings. The current report proves the assembly conditional on the explicit imported inputs.

C320_FORMAL_CORE.statement: Universal commutative-ring core: Taylor remainders for displacements in J^q I lie in J^(2q) I^2; nilpotent error filtrations terminate; nilpotent perturbations preserve units; polynomial residual memberships survive congruent sections. This is not a formalization of the topological or imported algebraicity inputs.

F_MT_NILPOTENT_LOCATOR.statement: Literal assertion at formal.tex:785: Apply the nilpotent correction of [MT, Lemma 3.9]. The actual named result is MT Lemma 6.7; no Lemma 3.9 occurs in the pinned MT paper.
